executive_summary.business_impact: The application contains critical vulnerabilities that could lead to data breaches and unauthorized access.
strengths: Well-known intentionally vulnerable application for training
strategic_recommendations: Review access controls on administrative endpoints

findings.title: Information Disclosure in Application Configuration Endpoint
findings.summary: The application exposes sensitive configuration data through an unprotected administrative endpoint.
findings.description: The /rest/admin/application-configuration endpoint exposes sensitive configuration information without proper authentication. This includes Google OAuth client IDs, server configuration details, product information, and other sensitive application settings.

technical_details.attack_vector: Direct access to endpoint without authentication
technical_details.impact: High - Exposes sensitive credentials and configuration
technical_details.testing_process: Accessed the endpoint directly via browser without authentication
technical_details.details: The endpoint returns the full application configuration including: Google OAuth client ID, server configuration, product details, chatbot configuration, and security settings. No authentication is required to access this endpoint.

findings.impact: An attacker can access sensitive configuration data including OAuth credentials, server details, and application internals. This information can be used to craft further attacks against the application.
recommendations: Implement proper authentication and access controls on administrative endpoints
Ensure sensitive configuration data is not exposed to unauthenticated users
Review and restrict access to all administrative endpoints
Consider implementing API keys or tokens for administrative access

findings.title: SQL Injection in Product Search
findings.summary: The product search functionality is vulnerable to SQL injection attacks, allowing arbitrary SQL code execution.
findings.description: The /rest/products/search endpoint is vulnerable to SQL injection attacks. The 'q' parameter does not properly sanitize user input, allowing an attacker to inject arbitrary SQL code. The payload '\'' OR '\''1'\''='\''1' successfully returns all products from the database.

technical_details.impact: Critical - Allows full database access and manipulation
technical_details.testing_process: Tested search endpoint with SQL injection payloads including '\'' OR '\''1'\''='\''1' which returned all products and '\'' UNION SELECT which generated SQLite error revealing database type
technical_details.details: The search endpoint concatenates user input directly into SQL queries without parameterization. Error messages reveal SQLite database information. The vulnerability allows attackers to manipulate the WHERE clause and potentially execute arbitrary SQL commands using UNION-based or boolean-based blind SQL injection techniques.

findings.impact: An attacker can extract, modify, or delete data from the database. This could lead to complete data compromise, authentication bypass, and potential server compromise.
recommendations: Implement parameterized queries or prepared statements for all database queries
Validate and sanitize all user inputs
Use an ORM that provides automatic escaping of SQL queries
Implement proper error handling that does not expose database details
